findings.passage: Friends, I take election integrity very seriously. That’s why I am supporting a proposed constitutional amendment that will be on the ballot November 4th: Proposition 16. This amendment would add language to the Texas Constitution to explicitly state that “persons who are not citizens of the United States” cannot vote in our state.
findings.note: His own newsletter post backing Proposition 16 of 2025, which writes the citizens-only voting rule into the state constitution. The same post says U.S. citizenship is already required to register to vote in Texas.
